# Cong Fan

> Cong Fan is a Brisbane-based AI product operator focused on practical AI products, agentic coding, automation workflows, and repo-level debugging for founders and small teams.

Canonical site: https://congfan.dev/
Contact: work@congfan.dev
Location: Brisbane, Australia
Languages: English or Chinese is fine.

## Useful Pages

- Home: https://congfan.dev/
- Field note: https://congfan.dev/field-notes/agentic-coding-loop

## What Cong Fan Does

- Builds practical AI product prototypes and working product surfaces.
- Uses agentic coding tools such as Codex and Claude Code against real repositories.
- Designs and debugs AI workflows involving Supabase, Stripe, n8n, and image/video generation systems.
- Helps founders and small teams turn messy workflows, repo issues, or AI product ideas into usable shipped artifacts.

## Services

- AI Product / Workflow Audit: AUD $690-$1,500.
- 10-Day AI Product / Agentic Coding Sprint: AUD $3,500-$8,000.
- Agentic Coding / Repo Debug Sprint: AUD $2,500-$6,000.
- Monthly AI Ops Retainer: AUD $2,000-$5,000/month.

## Selected Work

- ReelRush: AI image/video generation product work, generation flows, pricing and credits, public pages, deployment checks, and ongoing product operations.
- Ad Maker: Small-business AI ad generation workflow inside ReelRush.
- n8n + Supabase: Internal automation around company work emails, project management, metadata, and structured operational data.
- AS Component: B2B industrial website work across product pages, SEO structure, and sales-support pages.

## Fit

Best fit: solo founders, small businesses, startup product teams, and agencies with a real workflow, prototype, codebase, customer problem, or launch pressure.

Not a fit: pure prompt-writing lessons, low-budget outsourcing without product ownership, generic chatbot projects with no product strategy, or projects needing large-agency coverage.
